messages:
nina_data: Quick heads up — legacy CSV import from 2023-06 created ~120 duplicate contact rows across ~40 accounts. Looks like legacy_id was not mapped reliably. We should run a safe dedupe + remap job and a dry-run first. Any objections to a weekend run?

maria_cs: Ugh. Do duplicates live on the same account or are they split across accounts? Impact on playbooks/alerts? :thinking_face:

nina_data: Mostly duplicates on the same account (same account_id) but 18 contacts landed on wrong accounts (legacy_id collision). Playbooks that fire on new contacts could double-trigger. Example query I used to audit: 

-- find duplicate legacy ids
SELECT legacy_id, count(*) FROM contacts WHERE legacy_import = true GROUP BY legacy_id HAVING count(*) > 1;

This is safe to run as read-only for the audit.

devon_se: We should definitely dry-run the automated merger first. I can spin up the contact-merger playbook in staging and test the mapping rules (merge by legacy_id then by email). Can we add a TTL to avoid touching accounts in renewal window?

alex_pm: Heads-up on renewals: if owner changes happen mid-renewal it creates churn in RevOps reports. Let's add a temporary guard to skip accounts with renewal_date within 60d. Also pause any healthscore recalcs until after verification.

maria_cs: I can coordinate with the CSMs to flag any high-touch accounts. I'll make a spreadsheet of the 60-day renewals and add an opt-out column. Can run orchestration Sat night. :calendar:

playbook-bot: Automation queued: contact-merger-dryrun-2026-03-21 (staging) — ETA 45m. Logs will be posted to #automation-logs when complete.

devon_se: For the dry-run in prod-like staging, use this command locally to simulate: 

./scripts/dedupe.py --env=staging --dry-run --match=legacy_id --skip-renewals-days=60 --output=artifacts/dryrun_3512345678.json

That will produce a mapping file we can review before applying.

nina_data: I'll run the staging dry-run at 02:00 PT Sat and share artifacts + the SQL diff. Link will be posted here. Adding filter: "renewal_date >= now() + interval '60 days'" to the skip list and also excluding accounts flagged as "high_touch".

alex_pm: Please @revenue_ops when you post the mapping if any owner reassignments are suggested so they can approve before we push.

maria_cs: Also adding a quick checklist for CSMs: validate mapped contacts for top 20 ARR accounts after we run the merge. If anything looks off they should raise a ticket in #support.

nina_data: Sounds good — dry-run scheduled, will tag @revenue_ops and post artifacts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
